nodes.title: Round 7 F, after integration 7 (Brain 8cfd2416/73e6d920 and Studio 3dc6208a/8258bf8b are in): the four v2 pilot scripts are READY for data/lesson-scripts/: the full check (structure, Studio's board gate, runtime) passes on all four when they are in place. The copy waits for Brain: two of its tests (r7-brain-s2-worked, r7-brain-pilot #7) drive the c6/c5 lesson by v1 beats, and under v2 every explain beat asks a keyed question, so 'haan' to everything repairs instead of reaching the worked example. c6: the hexagon remediation board is now measured@1 { hexagon, m, sides [10,4,6,5,4,9], names A-F, trace }, and her line names each side with its length. The c6 explain beat e2 stays shape@1 with ONE side labelled 5 cm, because its point is that unlabelled sides still count: measured@1 labels every side and would erase that point. Three c5-ch02-t01 lines named part counts the board does not draw (W10). They now speak through the marks ('1/2 wala tukda', 'kyunki 3, 6 ka aadha hai'). check.mjs's measured@1 range now accepts polygons. data/lesson-scripts-v2/ stays until Brain's harness reads the live dir. Reverse if: the judges find e2's single label confusing next to measured boards.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-scripts-v2-live` (2026-11-05, F Learning)

The v2 rewrites of the four pilot topics (c4 equal shares, c5 number line, c5 compare fractions, c6 perimeter) are ready to become the live scripts in data/lesson-scripts/. The full check passes with them in place. The copy waits on Brain updating two tests that walk v1 beats.

**Board changes.** The c6 hexagon remediation moves to Studio's measured@1 polygon: six labelled sides, corners A to F, and a perimeter walk. Her spoken line now names each side with its length, so the board carries only what she says. The e2 explain board keeps shape@1 with a single 5 cm label on purpose. The teaching point is that a regular hexagon's unlabelled sides still belong to the perimeter, and measured@1 always labels every side.

**c5 rewording.** Studio's W10 gate flagged three c5-ch02-t01 lines that said '2 hisson', '3 gaps' or '7 hisse' while the line drew other counts. They now speak through the drawn marks instead.

**Staging.** data/lesson-scripts-v2/ is kept until Brain switches its side-by-side harness to the live dir.
